Header: Brevennia rehi Maavu Poochchi or Soorai

Prevention: Early transplanting to reduce mealybug pressure.
Remove grassy weeds which can harbor this insect.
Application of raw coir pith, raw sugarcane trash and farmyard manure to reduce infestations.
Destroy ant colonies as ants are commonly found with mealybugs.
Conserve natural enemies like small encyrtid wasps, ladybird beetles, hover flies, Chrysoperla and spiders by avoiding broad-spectrum pesticides.
Ponding of irrigation water at 5 cm depth throughout the growing period.
Monitoring: Monitor crops on a weekly basis during growing period.
Symtpoms include stunted growth, yellowing and curling of leaves.
Continuous monitoring in upland rice and rainfed cultivation.
Initial occurance at tender shoot of crop.
Mealybugs feed by sucking the sap from tender shoots.
Consider direct control actions as soon as pests are found.
Direct Control: Removal and destruction of affected plants.
Spraying of 1% Azadiractin at a rate of 400 ml per acre.
Spraying of fish oil resin soap (25 g per litre).
Restrictions: Always wear protective clothing when handling chemicals, follow product label instructions.
